s: The primary purpose of a Rythu Bazar in Andhra Pradesh is to
o: replace Agricultural Market Committees in all notified areas
provide subsidised agricultural inputs to tenant farmers
enable farmers to sell directly to consumers while ensuring better prices for farmers and fair prices for consumers
enable licensed traders to purchase agricultural produce from farmers through auctions
x: Rythu Bazars enable farmers to sell directly to consumers without middlemen. Their stated purpose is to provide a better price to farmers and a fair price to consumers.
tq: Test the core purpose and distinguish direct marketing from regulated wholesale marketing.

s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes a Rythu Bazar from a regulated market yard?

A Rythu Bazar charges a market fee of 1%, whereas a regulated market yard has no market fee.
A Rythu Bazar permits farmers to sell directly to consumers, whereas a regulated market yard involves farmers selling to licensed traders.
x: Farmers sell directly to consumers in Rythu Bazars, while farmers sell to licensed traders in regulated market yards. The other alternatives reverse the institutional and fee arrangements.
tq: Split the options by comparing seller, manager, legal basis and fee.
